name: Temple Gardens
summary: In Temple Gardens, water and bridges gather at the heart of Darnassus. The city bank stands on the main island, beside the Temple of the Moon to the south and a glowing tree portal to Teldrassil's base.

sections.title: Heart of the Elven Capital
sections.body: Water runs beneath wooden bridges through Darnassus's center. They link the Temple Gardens' islets with the Cenarion Enclave to the north, the terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south. Night elves tend the waters and foliage. Travelers and priestesses find a quiet place to rest.

sections.title: Gateway to Teldrassil
sections.body: Darnassus's central vault and bank occupy the main island. On its western bank, a great glowing pink tree portal carries travelers through the boughs to Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's base. From there, coastal docks and flight paths connect the World Tree to other destinations.

faq.q: What is the glowing pink portal in the gardens?
faq.answer: The glowing tree portal on the gardens' western edge carries travelers between Teldrassil's crown and base. It takes them to Rut'theran Village, where ships and hippogryphs connect the night elves to darkshore and the wider world.

faq.q: Where is the Darnassus bank located?
faq.answer: Darnassus's main bank occupies an open elven pavilion on the Temple Gardens' largest central island.

faq.q: Why are they called the Temple Gardens?
faq.answer: The gardens take their name from the Temple of the Moon, which borders them to the south.

faq.q: Which districts connect to the Temple Gardens?
faq.answer: Bridges cross the water from the Temple Gardens to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the Craftsmen's, Warrior's, and Tradesmen's Terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south.

angles.text: As a night elf, you find wilderness and civic architecture meeting in the gardens. They offer a quiet place for reflection amid Darnassus's daily affairs.
As an Alliance visitor arriving by ship, you pass through the Rut'theran portal to reach the city's tranquil waters and the rest of Darnassus.
